method_note: No paid keyword tool. Volume tiers estimated from public trend-tool snippets (e.g. box breathing shown at 18k to 60k/mo), relative autocomplete/PAA presence and topic breadth; difficulty tiers from who ranks (Healthline, Cleveland Clinic, WebMD, Mayo = 4-5; mixed blogs = 3; forums, Reddit, Substack, small tools = 1-2). All figures are directional tiers, US-focused, and should be validated in Search Console after launch.
